# FDG3034

> DO NOT give the same name to multiple types across namespaces within a single application model.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.4.1.1 Application Model Namespaces.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Application model namespaces are groups rarely used with other application models, such as `System.Windows*` and `System.Web.UI*`.

## From the book

For example, do not add a type named `Page` to the `System.Web.UI.Adapters` namespace, because the `System.Web.UI` namespace already contains a type named `Page`.
